characteristics: modular combat module mount (AGS-17 grenade launcher documented)
controllable via radio, fiber-optic, or satellite link depending on configuration
Strength: Russia's most regularly-observed UGV on the battlefield; modularity allows the same chassis to be reconfigured for different missions
Limitation: Radio-link control requires the operator to stay close to the platform - unlike Ukraine's Starlink-enabled longer-range control, this is a documented Russian-side limitation
Estimated quantity available: Most widely deployed Russian UGV type; exact fleet size not disclosed
employment_notes: Despite having weaponized variants demonstrated, its actual battlefield role has remained almost entirely logistics: one Ukrainian unit commander estimated 80-90% of both sides' ground robots are used primarily to transport supplies, not fight
contrast_vs_traditional: A modular tracked platform built to be reconfigured for logistics or combat roles as needed reflects the same doctrine.md force-structure point documented for small drone units generally: platforms procured and fitted out for what a sector actually needs, rather than issued as a fixed single-purpose vehicle.
